# Import data and libraries

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
##################################
# UPLOAD LIBRARIES AND FUNCTIONS #
##################################

library(tidyverse)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(glmnet)
library(depmixS4)
library(here)
source(here("fit_hmm.R"))
source(here("fit_lasso_per_gene.R"))

select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r}
###############
# UPLOAD DATA #
###############

methyl_raw <- read_tsv("data/methylation/methylation_data.tsv.gz")
colnames(methyl_raw)[1] <- "probe_id"
probe_map <- read_tsv("data/methylation/probe_map")
colnames(probe_map)[colnames(probe_map) == "#id"] <- "id"


rna_raw <- read_tsv("data/gene_expression/gene_expression_data.tsv.gz")
colnames(rna_raw)[1] <- "gene_id"

phenotype <- read_tsv("data/phenotype_data.tsv.gz")

# hg38_txdb reference of genome
hg38_txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene

```

```{r}
##################
# FILTER SAMPLES #
##################

# filter for primary tumor samples
samples <- pull(
  filter(phenotype, sample_type.samples == "Primary Tumor"),
  sample
)

# samples in all three datasets:
# methyl_matrix, rna_std, phenotype
matched_samples <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  colnames(methyl_raw)[-1],
  colnames(rna_raw)[-1],
  samples
))

length(matched_samples)
head(matched_samples)

# modify methyl and rna matrices to be matched subset
methyl_matrix <- select(methyl_raw, probe_id, all_of(matched_samples))
rna_matrix <- select(rna_raw, gene_id, all_of(matched_samples))
```

# Standardize RNA-seq IDs

```{r}
###################
# STANDARDIZE IDS #
###################

rna_with_ver <- mutate(rna_matrix, gene_id_no_ver = sub("\\..*$", "", gene_id ))

ensg_keys <- unique(rna_with_ver$gene_id_no_ver)
ensg_to_entrez <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = ensg_keys,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  column = "ENTREZID",
  multiVals = "first"
)

rna_std <- mutate(rna_with_ver, gene_id_entrez = as.character(ensg_to_entrez[gene_id_no_ver]))
rna_std <- filter(rna_std, !is.na(gene_id_entrez))
rna_std <- group_by(rna_std, gene_id_entrez)
rna_std <- summarize(rna_std, across(all_of(matched_samples), mean, na.rm = TRUE))
```


# Extract promoter regions

## Methylation

```{r, warning = FALSE}
################################################
# FILTER METHYLATION DATA FOR PROMOTER REGIONS #
################################################

methyl_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = probe_map$chrom,
                     ranges = IRanges(start = probe_map$chromStart, end = probe_map$chromEnd),
                     probe_id = probe_map$id)
mcols(methyl_gr)$probe_id <- probe_map$id

methyl_gr

promoter_regions <- promoters(genes(hg38_txdb, single.strand.genes.only=FALSE), upstream=2000, downstream=400)

probes_in_promoter <- probe_map$id[overlapsAny(methyl_gr, promoter_regions,
                                              ignore.strand = TRUE)]

methyl_filtered <- filter(methyl_matrix, probe_id %in% probes_in_promoter)

dim(methyl_filtered)
head(methyl_filtered)
```

## RNA-seq

```{r}
########################################
# FILTER RNA DATA FOR PROMOTER REGIONS #
########################################

hg38_genes <- genes(hg38_txdb)
rna_seq_ranges <- hg38_genes[hg38_genes$gene_id %in%
                unique(na.omit(rna_std$gene_id_entrez))]

head(rna_seq_ranges)

rna_seq_promoters <- promoters(rna_seq_ranges, upstream=2000, downstream=400)

length(rna_seq_promoters)

```

```{r}
################################
# MERGE METHYLATION AND RNA DATA #
################################

methyl_gr_filtered <- methyl_gr[mcols(methyl_gr)$probe_id %in% probes_in_promoter]
hits <- findOverlaps(rna_seq_promoters, methyl_gr_filtered, ignore.strand = TRUE)
length(hits)

probe_gene_map <- data.frame(
  probe_id = mcols(methyl_gr_filtered)$probe_id[subjectHits(hits)],
  gene_id_entrez = mcols(rna_seq_promoters)$gene_id[queryHits(hits)],
  chrom = as.character(seqnames(methyl_gr_filtered))[subjectHits(hits)],
  start = start(methyl_gr_filtered)[subjectHits(hits)]
)

methyl_long_format <- pivot_longer(
  methyl_filtered,
  cols = -probe_id,
  names_to = "sample_id",
  values_to = "beta"
)
methyl_long_format <- inner_join(methyl_long_format, probe_gene_map, by = "probe_id")

rna_long_format <- pivot_longer(
  rna_std,
  cols = -gene_id_entrez,
  names_to = "sample_id",
  values_to = "expression"
)

merged_df <- inner_join(methyl_long_format, rna_long_format, by = c("sample_id", "gene_id_entrez"))

head(merged_df)
```

```{r}
#########################################
# SAVE MERGED_DF AS FILE (JUST IN CASE) #
#########################################

write_csv(merged_df, "exports/merged_final.csv")

if (!exists("merged_df")) {
  merged_df <- read_csv("exports/merged_final.csv")
}

```

# Analyses

```{r}
##################
# LASSO ANALYSIS #
##################

set.seed(123)

# get 2000 genes with most CpG sites 
cpgs_per_gene <- summarize(group_by(merged_df, gene_id_entrez), n_cpgs = n_distinct(probe_id))

target_genes <- cpgs_per_gene %>%
  arrange(desc(n_cpgs)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 500) %>%
  pull(gene_id_entrez)

length(target_genes)

lasso_result <- NULL
lasso_result <- data.frame()
all_fits <- list()
for (gene in target_genes) {
  result <- fit_lasso_per_gene(gene, merged_df)
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    lasso_result <- bind_rows(lasso_result, result$summary)
    all_fits[[as.character(gene)]] <- result$cv_fit
  }
}

lasso_result

# better R^2 results than Zhong et al.,
# but we ran lasso for 500 genes as opposed to their 4000+
paste0("Percentage of genes with R^2 > 0.3 = ", mean(lasso_result$r_squared > 0.3, na.rm = TRUE)*100)
paste0("Percentage of genes with R^2 > 0.5 = ", mean(lasso_result$r_squared > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)*100)

```

```{r}
########################################
# SIGNAL VISUALS: WORST AND BEST GENES #
########################################

# signal visualization of worst (lowest R^2) and best (highest R^2) genes
worst_gene <- lasso_result %>%
  arrange(r_squared) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>% # first from ascending (by R^2 value) order of genes
  pull(gene_id_entrez)

best_gene <- lasso_result %>%
  arrange(desc(r_squared)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>% # first from descending (by R^2 value) order of genes
  pull(gene_id_entrez)

worst_fit <- all_fits[[as.character(worst_gene)]]
plot(worst_fit)
best_fit <- all_fits[[as.character(best_gene)]]
plot(best_fit)

```

```{r}
###############################
# Correlation analysis + plot #
###############################
# averaging all methylation values of a single gene to determine if there is
# a simple correlation between methylation and gene expression 

# average methylation per gene
gene_summary <- summarize(
  group_by(merged_df, gene_id_entrez),
  avg_methylation = mean(beta, na.rm = TRUE),
  avg_expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# correlation using all genes including those w/o expression 
# some may be silent due to reasons other than methylation
cor_all <- cor(gene_summary$avg_methylation, gene_summary$avg_expression,
               use = "complete.obs")
paste("correlation (all genes) = ", round(cor_all, 4))

# correlation using only genes with expression > 0
gene_summary_expressed <- filter(gene_summary, avg_expression > 0)
cor_expressed <- cor(gene_summary_expressed$avg_methylation, 
     gene_summary_expressed$avg_expression,
     use = "complete.obs")
paste("correlation (expressed genes only) = ", round(cor_expressed, 4))

ggplot(gene_summary_expressed,
       aes(x = avg_methylation, y = log1p(avg_expression))) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Average Promoter Methylation (%)",
       y = "Log Gene Expression/Log(Expected Count + 1)",
       title = "Promoter Methylation vs Gene Expression (Expressed Genes Only)")

```

```{r}
################
# HMM Analysis # 
################

# sort CpG sites by position in genome so that they can be modeled as sequence
hmm_data <- arrange(merged_df, gene_id_entrez, start)

# log-transform gene expression values
hmm_data$log_expression <- log1p(hmm_data$expression)

# use a variable for states
num_states <- 3

# one row per gene
gene_ids <- unique(hmm_data$gene_id_entrez)
# subset for testing
# gene_ids <- gene_ids[1:100]

# 80% train, 20% test
train_ids <- sample(length(gene_ids), size = floor(0.8*length(gene_ids)))
train_genes <- gene_ids[train_ids]
test_genes <- gene_ids[-train_ids]

# train hmm
state_exp <- data.frame()
source(here("fit_hmm.R"))
i <- 0
for (gene in train_genes) {
  i <- i + 1
  if (gene %in% state_exp$gene_id_entrez) {
      print(paste0("[", i, "/", length(train_genes), "] ", "Skipping ", gene))
      next
  }
  print(paste0("[", i, "/", length(train_genes), "] ", "Processing ", gene))
  result <- fit_hmm(gene, hmm_data, num_states = num_states)
  if(!is.null(result)) 
    state_exp <- rbind(state_exp, result)
}

# summarize state-specific regression coefficients to gene level
train_state_summary <- state_exp %>%
  group_by(gene_id_entrez) %>%
  summarize(
    log_expression = dplyr::first(log_expression),
    weighted_methyl_intercept = sum(state_prop * methyl_intercept, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_expr_intercept = sum(state_prop * expr_intercept, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_expr_slope = sum(state_prop * expr_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    dominant_state = state[which.max(state_prop)][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

train_lm <- lm(log_expression ~ weighted_expr_intercept + weighted_expr_slope,
               data = train_state_summary)
summary(train_lm)

# predict test gene expression
test_pred <- data.frame()
test_state_exp <- data.frame()
i <- 0
for (gene in test_genes) {
  i <- i + 1
  if (gene %in% test_state_exp$gene_id_entrez) {
      print(paste0("[", i, "/", length(test_genes), "] ", "Skipping ", gene))
      next
  }
  print(paste0("[", i, "/", length(test_genes), "] ", "Processing ", gene))

  result <- fit_hmm(gene, hmm_data, num_states = num_states)
  if (is.null(result))
    next
  
  test_state_exp <- rbind(test_state_exp, result)
}

test_state_summary <- test_state_exp %>%
  group_by(gene_id_entrez) %>%
  summarize(
    log_expression = dplyr::first(log_expression),
    weighted_methyl_intercept = sum(state_prop * methyl_intercept, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_expr_intercept = sum(state_prop * expr_intercept, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_expr_slope = sum(state_prop * expr_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    dominant_state = state[which.max(state_prop)][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pred_exp <- predict(train_lm, newdata = test_state_summary)
test_pred <- data.frame(actual = test_state_summary$log_expression,
                        pred = pred_exp)
  
hmm_r_squared <- (cor(test_pred$actual, test_pred$pred))^2

```

```{r}
################
# final values #
################
cat("R for simple correlation:",
    "\n\t all genes = ", cor_all,
    "\n\t expressed genes only = ", cor_expressed,
    "\nR^2 for LASSO = ", lasso_r_squared,
    "\nR^2 for HMM = ", hmm_r_squared)
```
